1) the Atlantic cod fishery in West Greenland collapsed because of high fishing pressure and climate change, 2) this collapse was driven by the disappearance of a locally adapted genetic population, 3) the disappearance was caused by a combination of climate change and fishing, and 4) the collapse was not predicted by the fishery management.
